verdict.rationale: Bolna documents Indian data residency for deployments where data must remain in India. It also offers self-hosting on your own servers via Docker or Kubernetes, which gives control over data location. Only one named residency region is evidenced, and there is no documented region selector. Missing for 10: a documented list of selectable regions beyond India, how residency is configured for hosted accounts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Indian data residency is available for deployments where data must remain in India.
Learn how to self-host Bolna Voice AI on your own servers using Docker or Kubernetes for secure, private, and scalable enterprise deployments.
